title: Refresh Anth.us foundational messaging
description: Migrated from Beads Anth.us-ymb. Refresh homepage mission/values bridge, about, ai-solutions, platform, and repeated foundational taglines while keeping the cybernetic philosophy as the lead frame and grounding claims in products, delivered systems, and case-study proof. Homepage work partially landed earlier; about, ai-solutions, platform, repeated taglines, and Ryan's decision on restoring four removed Values remain.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Marketing-aligned messaging rewrite landed on develop: cut Values to six (removed Design for Humans and Collaborate with AI Humanely); hero H1 + subhead now lead with self-aligning AI and the 14-year production-operations track record; siteMetadata.description set to the foundational tagline; ai-solutions replaced its 2023 taxonomy with the 4-domain framing (Knowledge Bases, Self-Aligning Automation, Agent Systems, Machine Learning) anchored by Call Criteria; about + platform SEO descriptions aligned. Builds clean. Not yet merged to main. Hire-path CTA (1b53c5) still parked pending a brief.
